metadata.purpose: Manually verified abstract-level claim excerpts in paraphrase
metadata.interpretation: All claims remain author-reported; independent verification of underlying studies and data is not implied.

claims.claim: The authors reported that six of eight scoped PICOs lacked comparative data, one was excluded because comparator evidence was abstract-only, and one MAIC was assessed.
claims.qualifier: Authors' evaluation of the published tovorafenib JCA; not independently re-analysed.

claims.claim: The authors reported insufficient documentation of prognostic variables and effect modifiers, and no designated primary analysis in the indirect comparison statistical analysis plan.
claims.qualifier: Authors' critical appraisal, not an independent regulatory finding.

claims.claim: In a simulated multiple myeloma validation case, the maximum absolute difference between conditional mean-covariate and marginalised survival curves was 1.6 percentage points.
claims.qualifier: Simulation and hypothetical treatment-economic inputs; not a general accuracy guarantee.

claims.claim: The authors stated that a 1,000-run Excel probabilistic sensitivity analysis executed within seconds under their conditional approximation.
claims.qualifier: Demonstration using a specific model; performance depends on implementation.

claims.claim: Among 86 AI-enabled evidence-synthesis abstracts from ISPOR Philadelphia 2026, 42 (49%) reported no core performance metric according to the presenting authors.
claims.qualifier: This Europe 2026 presentation analysed abstracts from the separate Philadelphia conference; denominator is not ISPOR Europe 2026.

claims.claim: The authors found that none of the 86 reviewed abstracts reported Work Saved over Sampling, their selected screening-efficiency metric.
claims.qualifier: Study-specific content analysis, not an audit of all ISPOR Europe presentations.

claims.claim: The authors reported public MFN-related positions in 14 of 17 European Economic Area countries assessed under their GDP-threshold definition.
claims.qualifier: Secondary targeted review and author classification; country policies not independently verified.

claims.claim: The authors concluded that tangible MFN-related European reforms remained limited, with most responses representing signalling or early-stage initiatives.
claims.qualifier: Interpretation offered in the presentation, not a comprehensive independent policy audit.

claims.claim: Across four oncology target trial emulations, the authors reported shifts in population, endpoint or intercurrent-event handling compared with the initial estimand.
claims.qualifier: Four registry-based case studies, not an estimate of the prevalence of estimand drift.

claims.claim: The authors proposed presenting intended and realised estimands side by side in before-and-after tables to document estimand changes.
claims.qualifier: Author recommendation, not an established reporting requirement.
